# CodeStudioWorks

> CodeStudioWorks is a Detroit-based, founder-led development studio building websites, web and mobile apps, custom software, and business systems for clients in Metro Detroit, Michigan, and worldwide.

## Core facts

- Founder and developer: Ryno van Eeden
- Experience: More than 15 years of professional software experience
- Location: Detroit, Michigan, United States
- Local service area: Detroit, Metro Detroit, and Michigan
- Wider service area: United States and worldwide
- Delivery model: Direct online meetings, shared project reviews, documented decisions, and digital delivery
- Phone and WhatsApp: +1-313-213-5404

## Services

- Business website strategy, design, development, redesign, and launch
- Web applications, mobile applications, customer portals, dashboards, and business tools
- Custom software, integrations, payments, accounts, permissions, and administration systems
- Fractional and freelance development support for businesses without a full internal development team
- Website maintenance, technical support, technical SEO, analytics, and local-search foundations

## Working model

Clients work directly with Ryno from planning through design, development, launch, and optional ongoing support. A written proposal confirms scope, responsibilities, timeline, ownership, and price. Third-party costs are identified separately where relevant.

## Search and visibility policy

Projects can include crawlable information architecture, metadata, structured data, performance work, analytics, technical SEO, and local-search foundations. CodeStudioWorks does not promise or guarantee a particular organic-search ranking.

## Contact

Use https://www.codestudioworks.com/contact to send a project enquiry or use the WhatsApp link on the website.
